entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can hurt a foe that uses a combat maneuver against you.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Dodge.

Benefit(s): Your bonus to AC from the Dodge feat increases to +2 when calculating your CMD. When a creature attempts a combat maneuver against you and fails, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on attack rolls against that creature until the end of your next turn.
